name: Rikuzen Natsumi
source: A first-year student who lives close to [url=/c68296]Kouichi's[/url] and goes to the same school as [url=/c68287]Mari[/url]. She is an only child but lives by herself because of her school and sometimes feel homesick. Calls Kouichi "onii-san" and is a honest and natural girl who easily trusts the people around her.
